SELECT H.EMPID AS EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME AS LOCAL_NAME, H.DEPTNO AS DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPTNAME, TO_CHAR(H.DATE_STARTED, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS DATE_STARTED, TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY') AS YEAR, TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STRT_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.TOT_VAC_CNT + A.ADD_VAC + A.LAST_YEAR_VAC) AS TOTAL_VAC, TO_CHAR(A.ADD_VAC) AS ADD_VAC, TO_CHAR(A.TOT_VAC_CNT) AS SPECIAL_VAC, TO_CHAR(A.LAST_YEAR_VAC) AS LAST_YEAR_VAC, TO_CHAR( A.USE_VAC_CNT + AR_USE_VACATION(TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), A.CPNY_ID, A.PERSON_ID, 'CONFIRM') + AR_USE_VACATION(TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), A.CPNY_ID, A.PERSON_ID, 'AFFIRM') ) AS USED_VAC, TO_CHAR( A.TOT_VAC_CNT + A.ADD_VAC + A.LAST_YEAR_VAC - A.USE_VAC_CNT - AR_USE_VACATION(TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), A.CPNY_ID, A.PERSON_ID, 'CONFIRM') - AR_USE_VACATION(TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(A.END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), A.CPNY_ID, A.PERSON_ID, 'AFFIRM') ) AS REMAIN_VAC FROM AR_VAC_EMP A INNER JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON A.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID WHERE A.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.ACTIVITY = 1 AND H.EMPID NOT LIKE '111111%' AND TO_CHAR(A.STRT_DATE, 'YYYY') = #{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS ( SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT ASI.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO ASI WHERE ASI.DEPTNO = H.DEPTNO AND ASI.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
AND ( UPPER(H.EMPID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(H.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' )
AND INSTR(',' || #{deptNos, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',', ',' || H.DEPTNO || ',') > 0
AND H.EMP_OFFICE = #{empOffice, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND H.EMP_TYPE_CODE = '14016053'
AND H.EMP_TYPE_CODE <> '14016053' AND (SELECT HPI.NATIONALITY_CODE FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HPI WHERE HPI.PERSON_ID = H.PERSON_ID) <> '872'
ORDER BY H.DEPTNO, H.EMPID
